definition_i18n.zh-TW: 從高處俯瞰或遠眺非山主體的全景題材：城市、海灣、平原、湖面、河谷、群島。與 mountain_view 的邊界以主體為準——「看的是山」歸 mountain_view，「從山上往下看別的東西」歸 overlook；兩者可同框但掛點以主體為準。核心判據是空氣透明度（遠景層次被霧霾吃掉），不是天氣戲劇性。
definition_i18n.en: Panoramic genre shot from height at a non-mountain subject: city, bay, plain, lake, river valley, archipelago. The boundary with mountain_view follows the subject - 'the mountains are the subject' belongs to mountain_view, 'looking down at something else from a mountain' belongs to overlook; they may share the frame but attribution follows the subject. The core judgment is air clarity (distant layers are eaten by haze), not weather drama.
definition_i18n.ja: 高所から非山岳主題を見下ろす/遠望するパノラマ題材：都市、湾、平野、湖、河谷、諸島。mountain_viewとの境界は主題で決める。核心の判断は大気の透明度（遠景の階調がヘイズに食べられる）であり、天気の劇 dramatさではない。

description_i18n.zh-TW: 眺望目標的典型距離（公里）：市區 ~10、海灣/湖面 ~20-50、遠山脈/群島 50+。用於能見度門檻求值。
description_i18n.en: Typical distance to the viewed target (km): urban ~10, bay/lake ~20-50, distant ranges 50+. Used to evaluate the visibility threshold.
description_i18n.ja: 眺望対象の典型的距離（km）。市街地~10、湾/湖~20-50、遠い山脈50+。視程閾値の評価に使用。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 能見度 ≥ min(眺望距離, 24 km)：遠景清晰度的直接代理。誠實標註：GFS/Open-Meteo 能見度欄位上限約 24 km，超過後此判據鈍化（報 24 km 不代表能看 100 km）——長距離眺望由 V2（AOD）承擔真實判別。
rationale_i18n.en: Visibility >= min(view range, 24 km): the direct proxy for distant-layer clarity. Honest note: the GFS/Open-Meteo visibility field caps near 24 km, so beyond that this criterion saturates (24 km reported does not mean 100 km visible) - long-range discrimination is carried by V2 (AOD).
rationale_i18n.ja: 視程≥min(眺望距離, 24km)。遠景の鮮明さの直接的代理。GFS/Open-Meteoの視程は約24kmで飽和するため、長距離の判別はV2(AOD)が担う。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: AOD ≤0.4：長程能見度的實際決定因子（氣溶膠消光）。比 night_sky（0.3）寬、比 sunset（0.6）嚴——俯瞰全景需要跨數十公里的層次對比。provisional，長距離景點校準第一優先。
rationale_i18n.en: AOD <= 0.4: the actual determinant of long-range visibility (aerosol extinction). Looser than night_sky (0.3), tighter than sunset (0.6) - a panorama needs layered contrast across tens of kilometres. Provisional; top calibration priority for long-range spots.
rationale_i18n.ja: AOD≤0.4。長距離視程の実質的决定因子。night_sky(0.3)より緩くsunset(0.6)より厳しい。暫定値。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 總雲量 ≤70%：全景不需要無雲——天空中的雲是構圖元素，只擋連續陰幕蓋住目標全域的情況。比 sunset（低雲方位判據）寬，因為俯瞰主體在地面上。
rationale_i18n.en: Total cloud <= 70%: a panorama does not need a clear sky - clouds in the sky are compositional elements; only a continuous deck covering the whole target is vetoed. Looser than sunset's azimuth-based low-cloud criterion because the subject is on the ground.
rationale_i18n.ja: 全雲量≤70%。パノラマに晴天は不要。雲は構図要素。連続雲層が対象全体を覆う場合のみ否決。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 降雨 <0.2 mm/h：拍攝本身不受影響（沿用已審門檻）。
rationale_i18n.en: Precipitation < 0.2 mm/h: shooting unaffected (approved threshold carried over).
rationale_i18n.ja: 降水<0.2mm/h。撮影への影響なし。

review_note_i18n.zh-TW: 草稿待 owner 複審（2026-10-26 命名裁定：overlook，不用 vista 以避免英文語意上涵蓋 mountain_view 的父集宣稱）。判據由已審契約同構推導；V2 0.4 與 V3 70% 為新擬 provisional；V1 的 24 km 欄位上限缺口已誠實標註。預計收容 unsure 名單 17 個高處俯瞰機會。
review_note_i18n.en: Draft pending owner review (2026-10-26 naming decision: overlook, not vista, to avoid the English superset claim over mountain_view). Derived structurally from approved contracts; V2 0.4 and V3 70% are newly proposed provisional values; the 24 km field-cap gap is honestly documented. Expected to house 17 high-vantage opportunities from the unsure list.
review_note_i18n.ja: ドラフト。命名は2026-10-26裁定（vista ではなく overlook）。V2 0.4 と V3 70% は新規暫定値。24kmの飽和限界は誠実に注記。unsure名簿の17件を収容予定。
